notes: Bit rate support stated as 100 Mbps to 1.25 Gbps. Protocols: FE, GbE, 1G FC, STM1/OC3, STM4/OC12. Power budget 0–14dB; dispersion penalty Max 1dB (table summary). Operating temperature: 0°C to +70°C (C-temp); -40°C to +85°C (I-temp, ordering SO-CSFP-1000Base-BX20D-43-O2-I). Power consumption: < 1.0W per BiDi channel. Footnote 1) Average power for Tx/Rx power levels. Footnote 2) Receiver minimum input power and overload @ 1.25Gbps, BER ≤ 1x10-12, PRBS 27-1, back-to-back. Tx/Rx nominal wavelengths 1490nm/1310nm; transmit wavelength 1490nm–1500nm; receiver wavelength range 1260–1360nm. DDM Yes. Two BiDi channels (2x LC) on CSFP.
suggestions: Schema temp_min_c/temp_max_c are singular floats; this part has distinct C-temp (0 to +70°C) and I-temp (-40 to +85°C) variants. Consider variant-specific fields or list-of-ranges. bit_rate_gbps could accept Mbps literals (100) or a paired unit field to avoid Gbps-only conversion for 100 Mbps.
